$comment: Sentinel Hardening Model v1 — NOT CVSS.
Missing security headers and weak configuration are absent mitigations,
not independently exploitable vulnerabilities, so they are deliberately
kept out of CVSS. base_impact is a Sentinel-internal 0-100 hardening
weight, documented here so every value lives in one auditable place
rather than being scattered through the codebase.
Rationale for the ordering: HSTS and CSP remove protections against
whole attack classes; Referrer-Policy leaks metadata only.
scale: 0-100 Sentinel hardening weight (not a CVSS score)

missing_csp.label: Missing Content-Security-Policy
missing_csp.rationale: Removes script-source restrictions that would contain an injection flaw.

missing_hsts.label: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
missing_hsts.rationale: Browsers without a cached HSTS policy may be exposed on first connection.

missing_x_frame_options.label: Missing X-Frame-Options
missing_x_frame_options.rationale: Page may be framed by another site (clickjacking surface).

missing_x_content_type_options.label: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
missing_x_content_type_options.rationale: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses instead of trusting the declared type.

missing_referrer_policy.label: Missing Referrer-Policy
missing_referrer_policy.rationale: Full URLs may leak to third parties via the Referer header.

weak_cookie_session.label: Session cookie missing security attributes
weak_cookie_session.rationale: A session cookie without HttpOnly/Secure is materially weaker.

weak_cookie_unknown.label: Unknown cookie missing security attributes
weak_cookie_unknown.rationale: Cookie contents undetermined; treated as hardening only.

directory_listing.label: Directory listing enabled
directory_listing.rationale: Exposes file inventory that aids further discovery.

version_disclosure.label: Software version disclosure
version_disclosure.rationale: Lets an attacker match the target to known version-specific issues.

permissive_cors.label: Permissive CORS configuration
permissive_cors.rationale: Wildcard origin with credentials weakens same-origin protection.

default.label: Security hardening issue
default.rationale: Generic hardening weakness with no specific rule.

exposure.$comment: Bounded, diminishing exposure multiplier applied to breadth.
